title: TeamInviteLink
description: A team invite link (ADR-0046, people.rules.md PE-38 and PE-39): a single-use, expiring bearer link that a lead of `team` (or an org owner) makes, and that one signed-in person of the org redeems to join that team. The record is tilo-api's own and never leaves it as is: it holds no token, nonce, signature or URL, only `nonce_sha256` (the SHA-256 of the token's 32 random nonce bytes, lowercase hex) and the `key_id` whose HMAC key signed the token. `created_by` is the maker and the server clock (PE-19). `status` is `pending` until one redemption (`redeemed`, the redeemer's stamp) or a revocation (`revoked`, the revoker's stamp) ends it; neither ever returns to `pending`. Expiry is never stored: a `pending` link with `expires_at` at or before the request is expired and redeems nothing. Who may make, revoke and redeem a link, and what a redemption writes, are rules this schema cannot see (PE-38, PE-39).

if.description: PE-38: a pending link carries neither end stamp.
PE-38: a redeemed link carries the redeemer's stamp and no revocation; a revoked one the revoker's stamp and no redemption.

id.description: til_ and 24 lowercase hex characters (96 random bits), minted by tilo-api.

key_id.description: Which configured HMAC key signed the token (the token's kid). Never the key itself.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the 32 raw nonce bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters.

status.description: pending, then redeemed or revoked, never back. Expired is derived from expires_at and never stored.
